note: Round 6 triage pass: every mutant re-extracted and re-derived, no law run (max_law_runs 0). Law runs for the mutants this pass leaves incomplete are in the per-mutant records a1_run_<id>.json beside this file. Equivalence was judged from each diff before any run: none of the 12 is equivalent (each changes an observable value or outcome for some input), as each note says.

mutations.expect: off-by-one offset in the Solidity loader getter getPrevStateHash: finalizeBatch compares finalizedStateRoots[i-1] with bytes 88..119 of the header, not the prevStateRoot the commit path stored at 89..120, so finalization fails for every real header. A PAR round trip of the commit-path encoder against the Solidity getters, or a DISCH law on finalizeBatch's prev-root guard, should move. Not equivalent: byte 88 is the last byte of blobVersionedHash.

off-by-one loop bound in challengeState: the last committed batch no longer gets its finalizeTimestamp extended by proofWindow while another batch is challenged. The O12 laws over challengeState's accumulating loop should see it. Not equivalent whenever lastCommittedBatchIndex > batchIndex.

missing clear in revertBatch: committedBatches[i] keeps its hash after the revert, so a recommit of index i reverts with 'batch already committed'. UNDO's commit/revert pair and residue laws should move (a new live residue on committedBatches). Not equivalent: the slot is nonzero after the revert.

wrong index in finalizeBatch's cleanup: it deletes the just-finalized batch's data and leaves batch i-1's forever. Not equivalent: batchDataStore[i] is zero and batchDataStore[i-1] nonzero after the call.

boundary off-by-one in proveState's timeout: at block.timestamp == startTime + proofWindow the prover is allowed to prove instead of the challenger winning by timeout. Not equivalent at that one timestamp.

dropped guard: initialize4's cutover can run while a challenge is in progress. The DISCH laws of the guard at Rollup.sol:213 lose their site; a NAT or cutover law should see the cutover run during a challenge. Not equivalent: initialize4 succeeds with inChallenge true.

dropped term in sendMessage's payment guard: msg.value need only cover the fee, and the unchecked refund msg.value - _fee - _value wraps. The SORT payer laws at L1CrossDomainMessenger.sol:291 should move. Not equivalent for msg.value in [_fee, _fee + _value).

swapped cursor in the enqueue: the enqueue time is written one slot ahead, so the new message's own enqueue time stays 0 (the sentinel). The SYM sentinel laws at :377 should move. Not equivalent: messageEnqueueTime[q] is 0 after the call.
off-by-one offset in the Go getter BatchHeaderBytes.BatchIndex: the round trips of BatchIndex should go PROVED -> REFUTED.
swapped field in BatchHeaderV1.Bytes: PrevStateRoot is written where PostStateRoot belongs; the v1 cross-component codec law and the V1 Go round trip of PostStateRoot should go PROVED -> REFUTED.
off-by-one offset in HeightFromBlockContextBytes: the go round trips with BuildBlockContext should go PROVED -> REFUTED.

off-by-one offset in the Solidity store storeTotalL1MessagePopped: the commit-path header shifts totalL1MessagePopped one byte left; the Sol->Go round trips of TotalL1MessagePopped and L1MessagePopped should go PROVED -> REFUTED.
